blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu – A total of 72 applicants were hired on the spot (HOTs) during the “Fiesta sa Lapu-Lapu Local and Overseas Job Fair” held at the activity center of The Outlets at MEPZ II Estate, Pueblo Verde, Barangay Basak, Lapu-Lapu City, on Wednesday, November 18, 2026. The job fair was organized by the Lapu-Lapu City Government, through its Public Employment Service Office (PESO), in partnership with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) Region VII, the Office of Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian, Aboitiz Economic Estates, and MEZ 2 Estate.
